About.title: About FAOS - Our Heritage of Purity
About.description: FAOS is a premier purveyor of organic olive oil and honey, meticulously crafted from 100% natural ingredients. Our digital brochure provides an in-depth look at our curated product range and our unwavering commitment to quality.
About.philosophy: Our philosophy is rooted in the harmony between nature and health, ensuring every drop is as pure as nature intended.
About.quality: We adhere to the highest international organic standards, bringing only the finest, chemical-free products to your table.
About.origin: Sourced from the heart of fertile lands, our products embody the rich heritage and traditional wisdom of organic farming.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.content: FAOS is deeply committed to protecting the <important>privacy</important> and <important>personal data</important> of all our users. Every piece of information relating to an identifiable individual is treated as strictly <important>confidential</important> and maintained in a <important>secure manner</important>. This includes, but is not limited to, personally identifiable information such as full names, contact details, and <important>transaction data</important>. To ensure maximum safety, FAOS implements rigorous <important>technical and organizational security measures</important> designed to prevent <important>unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration, or destruction</important> of your data. All personal information is collected and processed solely for <important>legitimate business purposes</important> and in strict accordance with <important>applicable data protection laws</important>. We guarantee that your personal data will not be disclosed to <important>third parties</important> without your <important>prior consent</important>, except where strictly required by legal obligations.

Header.title: Payment Methods & Security
Header.description: We offer a variety of secure and convenient payment options to ensure a smooth shopping experience for our customers.

HowToShop.title: How to Start Shopping
HowToShop.ariaLabel: Guide on how to start purchasing products
HowToShop.step1: 1. Browse our premium collection, select the items you desire, and click <important>“Add to Cart”</important> to save them to your shopping bag.
HowToShop.step2: 2. Open your shopping cart at the top right corner to review your selected items, adjust quantities, or remove products as needed.
HowToShop.step3: 3. Once you are satisfied with your selection, click <important>“Place Order”</important> to proceed to the secure checkout system.
HowToShop.step4: 4. You will be securely redirected to our payment partner, Stripe, where you can safely enter your payment details and finalize your purchase.

CardPayment.title: Pay via Debit / Credit Card
CardPayment.ariaLabel: Instruction for payment using debit or credit card
CardPayment.description: We support a wide range of global payment networks. You can securely pay with debit or credit cards from all major banks worldwide.
CardPayment.acceptedCards: We accept cards with the <important>Visa, Mastercard, or JCB</important> logo, including virtual cards and international credit cards for your convenience.
CardPayment.securityNote: Your transaction is encrypted and secured by Stripe's industry-leading technology.

QRCodePayment.title: Pay with QR Code (Mobile Banking)
QRCodePayment.ariaLabel: Instruction for payment using QR Code
QRCodePayment.description: For a faster checkout experience, you can pay instantly via QR Code. This method is highly recommended for users in Thailand.
QRCodePayment.method: Simply scan the <important>PromptPay QR Code</important> through your mobile banking application. This service is supported by all major Thai banks with no additional transaction fees.
QRCodePayment.expiryNote: * Please ensure the payment is completed within the specified time displayed on the QR page.

advertise.title: Why Honey & Olive Oil are the Top Choices for Health Enthusiasts?
messages: 100% pure honey is a clean, natural energy source that instantly revitalizes your body without the heavy, cloying sweetness of processed sugars.
Packed with high levels of natural antioxidants, it acts as a vital shield to boost your immune system and keep you feeling strong every single day.
Our premium olive oil is rich in healthy fats (HDL), an essential nutrient that actively supports heart health and promotes efficient blood circulation.
Switching to olive oil for your daily cooking helps lower bad cholesterol and significantly contributes to your long-term physical well-being and vitality.
The natural properties of honey provide excellent relief for sore throats while containing enzymes that help balance your digestive and excretory systems.
Rich in polyphenols, it helps slow down cellular aging while nourishing your skin to look radiant, healthy, and youthful from the inside out.
Carefully selected to ensure 100% natural origin, free from additives and zero trans fats, giving you complete peace of mind with every single serving.
The perfect choice for health enthusiasts, seniors, and anyone who pays close attention to the quality and origin of the ingredients they consume.
Incredibly versatile for any meal—whether you’re cooking your favorite dish, mixing it into a healthy drink, or enjoying it fresh for maximum benefits.
Don't wait for tomorrow; start prioritizing your health today by choosing premium, natural ingredients that truly make a difference in your life.
advertise.description: A healthier life is within reach—it all starts with choosing better, high-quality natural ingredients for your daily meals.
